anomalies.observed: The LD39200 output is on net +3.3V, while a separate +3V3 net exists with no regulator source. FCC2 VDD pins 11/27/50/75/100, VDDA pin21, and VREF+ pin20 are on unconnected nets; the VREF+_FCC net is instead tied to FCC2 PH1 pin13. NAVC2 VDD pins 19/32/48/64 and VSSA pin12 are unconnected, NAVC2 VSS pins 18/63 are tied only to each other and not to GND, and NAVC2 VDDA pin13 is on floating VDDA_NAVC.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the 3.3V LDO produces the 3V3 rail and that 3V3 feeds both MCUs and the sensors. All MCU VDD/VDDA/VREF+ pins should be connected to the 3.3V supply and all VSS/VSSA pins to ground, with no unpowered separate +3V3 rail.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The MCUs are not powered or properly grounded, and the +3V3 pull-up/connector rail is not sourced. The board would not boot normally and the I2C buses would not operate.

anomalies.observed: HSE2 is connected to FCC2 PE6 and, through R39, to FCC2 PE7, while FCC2 PH0/PH1 are on separate nets containing only capacitors/reference-network nodes. HSE3 is connected only to passive nodes C102/C109/R94, while NAVC2 PH0/PH1 are on separate capacitor-only nets.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists a high-speed external 25 MHz crystal for both MCUs. For STM32H753 and STM32F405 the HSE crystal should be connected to the MCU oscillator pins PH0/PH1 with the load capacitors.

evidence.quote: HSE crystal (both MCUs) | FCC / NAVC | ABM8G-25.000MHZ-4Y-T3

anomalies.impact: The intended external HSE clock is not connected to the MCU oscillator pins. The MCU may fall back to an internal oscillator or fail to start, changing system timing and peripheral behavior.

anomalies.observed: No component with value or part otter_CH330 is present in the netlist. USB5 and USB6 D+/D- pins are explicitly unconnected, and USB3 data pins connect only through series resistors to single-node nets.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the Connections section contains two otter_CH330 UART-to-USB converters for programming/debug.
anomalies.impact: The intended USB-to-UART debug/programming paths are absent, so the USB connectors cannot provide the specified serial link.
